messages:
alex_dev: Quick sync — VertexSilicon seed lab seats are ready to allocate. Partner requested 6 lab seats, embargoed firmware. Need: (1) NDA signed, (2) shipping contact, (3) bench harness version. Who can own seat assignment?
marie_pm: I can own seat allocation and comms. Timeline check: can we get units shipped by next Wed?
raj_ops: I can handle shipping + rack prep. Are these bare sleds or full rack units? Packing list?
tanya_vs: Hi! They're half-width sleds (sled form factor, no rack trays). We'll send DocuSign for the NDA by EOD. Embargo lift target: 2026-05-10. We'll need SOW countersign and serial tracking on arrival.
alex_dev: Copy. I'll loop in legal. lab QA will need bench harness v2.4 and the `redwood-runbench` script. Quick bench command we'll run:
```bash
redwood-runbench --model gptx-6b --seq 2048 --runs 5 --report json > vs_seed_results.json
```
olivia_qa: I can take benches for seats 1-2. Need kernel module v1.8 for NVMe passthrough — can ops confirm we can load it in the seed lab image?
raj_ops: Noted. Shipping address for paperwork: Redwood Inference - Seed Lab, 400 Market St, San Mateo CA 94401. Contact: Raj S (ops). Phone: +1-650-555-0199.
tanya_vs: We'll ship with signature required and sticky serial labels on each sled. Also send chain-of-custody form; I'll drop a link in a follow-up.
ship-bot: Shipment created on carrier FastLine, tracking FL123456789, ETA 2026-04-25. :ship:
marie_pm: Let's keep external communications dark until embargo lift. Internal stakeholders: @olivia_qa, @raj_ops, @alex_dev. I'll add a hold note for marketing and partners.
alex_dev: :thumbsup: I'll prepare the bench artifacts and a short runbook and post to #eng-ml once NDA is confirmed.
tanya_vs: DocuSign sent to legal@redwood.com. Expect countersign by Monday morning.
olivia_qa: Reserving bench blocks Apr 27-28 for soak and initial regression. Tag me when firmware arrives so I can line up test vectors.
raj_ops: I'll schedule carrier pickup once DocuSign is complete. Tentative lab ETA Apr 24 to allow a day for inventory + labeling.
marie_pm: :eyes: Great. I'll create a milestone in the partner board and a rollout card with owners + acceptance criteria (bench pass, logs uploaded, serials recorded).
